title: Booty blasting for Saba
author: Travis S.
desc: Targeting glutes, hamstrings, quads, shoulders, biceps, triceps, shoulders

ex.note: Keep chest up, a tight core, and drive through your heels
Pause 1-2 seconds at top (squeeze!). Find a foot position that's comfortable and natural Shoulder blades in contact with the seatback

8-12 reps -- when you can get the same weight for 12 across all 3 sets, increase weight.

Keep your back in contact with the seatback. Lower to right angle. Can angle elbows forward up to 45 degrees

ss.note: 12-15 reps -- when you can get the same weight for 15 across all 3 sets, increase weight
12-15 reps -- when you can get the same weight for 15 across all 3 sets, increase weight

ex.note: To find foot position, sit and extend your plant leg (doesn't have to be perfectly straight). Stand straight up and down when squatting for quad or lean  forward at the waist for glute/hammy
Optional but try to do 1x/week
